components.name: Main content area
components.overview: Generated-image content and the supplied loading, access-limit and error presentations. The collection includes three image results and seven generation states.
notes: Canonical set: 1134 × 608 px. Property 1 contains five actual component variants; selectedIndex and mainStatus expose nested image interactions.
The older documentation card says 10 supplied configurations. Its error presentations are available under Error states; the current Main content set has five variants.
The source portrait main artwork differs from its first thumbnail. The default preserves the supplied main artwork.

components.name: History panel
components.overview: The vertical creation-history rail in three supplied configurations. Each rail preserves its thumbnails and the available New creation and See all actions.
notes: 54 × 608 px. Full shows seven history entries, half five, unsigned in one. Original source spelling is preserved.
selectedIndex is a runtime selection control; New creation and See all are callback integration points.

components.name: SERP Carousel
components.overview: A carousel of different style templates for image generation.
notes: 1208 × 283 px. Six 200 px source template cards with 16 px gaps; the last card is clipped by the source viewport.
The source contains six category labels but supplies only the line-drawing template set. Other tabs explicitly identify the missing examples rather than invent artwork.
Source label Mandela line drawing is preserved. The documentation frame's internal name Style menu is stale; its visible title is SERP Carousel.

components.name: SERP · AIGC Answer
components.overview: The supplied landscape SERP composition with the Bing Creator answer. It combines image content, the title head, image actions and creation history within the search-results layout.

props.name: query
props.default: Create an image of a cute bear with big sparkling eyes, sitting on a green meadow surrounded by flowers and sun rays. Bright colors, fairy-tale style, soft shadows

notes: 1600 × 1000 px page. Bing Creator title at x220/y152; main content at x220/y194; 54 px history rail at x1374/y194; action row at y806.
Result and Error select two supplied scene presentations, not a claimed Figma component-set axis. The third spec card repeats the error presentation.
The AIGC content is reusable React. Page chrome is a local preview; authentication, generation, sharing and download require host callbacks. Mosaic intentionally excludes platform chrome.
